orchestrator.description: Orchestrates issue fixing and finding workflows - delegates to specialized subagents

security-1.description: Security analysis agent - finds auth bypass, injection, crypto failures, secrets

critical-1.description: Critical bug analysis agent - finds panics, unwrap on None/Error, OOB access

performance-1.description: Performance analysis agent - finds memory leaks, slow algos, missing caches

reliability-1.description: Reliability analysis agent - finds missing error handling, poor errors

testing-1.description: Testing analysis agent - finds missing tests, low coverage

tech-debt-1.description: Technical debt analysis agent - finds code duplication, dead code

validator-content-1.description: Content validation agent - reviews issue content for clarity

validator-structure-1.description: Structure validation agent - reviews issue structure

fix-issue-validator.description: Validator for fix-issue command - scores implementation
